cmd:
set -e
! rg --invert-match '^objects-candidate-v4(/|$)' archive-members.txt
! rg '(^|/)\.\.(/|$)' archive-members.txt
mkdir -m 700 payload
/bin/tar --extract --file=candidate-artifacts.tar --directory=payload --no-same-owner > archive-extract.stdout 2> archive-extract.stderr
find payload/objects-candidate-v4 -type f -printf '%P\n' | LC_ALL=C sort > payload-files.txt
find payload/objects-candidate-v4 ! -type f ! -type d -print > payload-nonregular.txt
test ! -s payload-nonregular.txt
sed 's#  /home/david/buster-fast-bench/codex-883-qualification-ce1-cecd-hot-v4/objects-candidate-v4/#  #' collect-all-artifact-hashes.stdout > collected-artifacts-relative.sha256
